(5) fuel genuinely enabled -> the arm_fuel/consume_fuel:false canary test in 'AC1/AC5' block. (6) fuel/memory/timeout distinguishable by pattern match -> 'AC6' describe block. (7) divergence recorded in moduledoc -> 'AC7' describe block (2 tests). Independently re-applied both reported gap mutations by hand (not trusting the report): (a) changed `@fuel_exhausted_substring "all fuel consumed by WebAssembly"` to `@fuel_exhausted_substring "fuel"` in resource_limits.ex, reran the suite -- got 'Result: 11/12 passed', with exactly the new false-positive test ('an ordinary trap message that incidentally contains the bare word fuel... classifies as {:trap, _}') failing (left: :fuel_exhausted, right: {:trap, ...}) -- matches the reported finding exactly. (b) Replaced the moduledoc with an adversarial paragraph planting the literal fragments 'DIVERGENCE', 'WASM-10', and 'does **NOT** trap' inside an unrelated sentence about retry-exhaustion, with no mention of memory.grow/StoreLimits.memory_size/the design-doc filename/decision 0014 -- reran the suite, got 'Result: 11/12 passed' with the original loose AC7 test ('the moduledoc states memory.grow beyond the cap does NOT trap') staying GREEN and the new stronger AC7 test ('cites the actual mechanism terms and the design doc/decision record') correctly failing on `assert moduledoc =~ "memory.grow"` -- matches the reported finding exactly, confirming the new test is the one doing the discriminating work, not the pre-existing loose checks. Reverted with `git checkout --`, confirmed `git status --porcelain lib/ test/` returned empty and a byte-diff against the pre-mutation copy showed IDENTICAL. Final confirmation reruns after both reverts: `mix test test/letflow/engine/wasm/resource_limits_test.exs` -> 'Result: 12 passed', `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> clean. No overclaim found in TEST-DESIGNER's report; both genuine-gap findings independently reproduced with matching pass/fail counts and failure messages. resource_limits.ex confirmed untouched (working tree clean at handoff time).
